name: rc_operating_cases
untested_conditions: Supply below 4.5 V or above 5.5 V.
Load steps below 0.5 mA or above 1.5 mA, short circuits, and open circuits.
Temperature variation, capacitor ESR/ESL, resistor temperature coefficient, and other parasitics; the fixture components are ideal.
Repeated power cycling and events outside the first startup, load step, and shutdown windows.

measurements.directive: meas tran vin_peak MAX v(in) FROM=0u TO=400u
measurements.description: Applied supply level at the selected minimum, nominal, and maximum input cases.

measurements.directive: meas tran vout_100u FIND v(out) AT=100u
measurements.description: Startup response near one nominal time constant.

measurements.directive: meas tran startup_rise_time TRIG v(out) VAL=0.45 RISE=1 TARG v(out) VAL=4.05 RISE=1
measurements.description: Rise time to 90 percent of the minimum selected supply.

measurements.directive: meas tran load_step_delta PP v(out) FROM=490u TO=610u
measurements.description: Peak-to-peak output movement after a load step on an established output.

measurements.directive: meas tran shutdown_voltage FIND v(out) AT=900u
measurements.description: Output voltage 100 microseconds after input shutdown.
